def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); G=[row[:] for row in g]
    # find diamond centers: cell whose 4 orthogonal neighbours are all 3
    centers=[(r,c,G[r][c]) for r in range(1,h-1) for c in range(1,w-1)
             if G[r-1][c]==G[r+1][c]==G[r][c-1]==G[r][c+1]==3]
    colored=[(r,c,v) for r,c,v in centers if v!=0]
    plain=[(r,c) for r,c,v in centers if v==0]
    def ray(r,c,dr,dc,color,skip_nonzero):
        r,c=r+2*dr,c+2*dc   # start beyond own arms
        while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
            v=G[r][c]
            if v==3: break           # another diamond's arm stops the ray
            if v==0: G[r][c]=color
            elif not skip_nonzero: break
            r+=dr; c+=dc
    # vertical rays first (they win crossings), then horizontal rays
    for r,c,v in colored:
        ray(r,c,1,0,v,False); ray(r,c,-1,0,v,False)
    for r,c,v in colored:
        ray(r,c,0,1,v,True); ray(r,c,0,-1,v,True)
    # centerless diamond: its column is cut (erased except the 3-cells)
    for pr,pc in plain:
        for r in range(h):
            if G[r][pc]!=3: G[r][pc]=0
    return G
